column5: The original urlStash method passes the first word to dispatch_once and returns the dictionary in the second word. The same four-word storage holds the lock predicate and NSLock in its third and fourth words.
The global block literal at 0xe1268 holds this invoke pointer, which creates the stash dictionary with nonretaining values.
The global block literal at 0xe1290 holds this invoke pointer, which initializes the stash lock.
The collection sharedInstance method uses the second word as its once predicate and returns the singleton stored in the first word by the initialization block.
The global block literal at 0xe1198 holds the invoke pointer for allocating the shared tracker collection.
The expiration block passed to UIApplication resets the captured click tracker. The archive member names this invoke function.
The expiration block descriptor at 0xe0de0 points to this helper for retaining the captured click tracker.
The expiration block descriptor at 0xe0de0 points to this helper for disposing of the captured click tracker.
The session initializer calls the UUID-and-MD5 helper named in GADSession.o and stores its 64-bit result in its sessionID ivar.
The report utility sharedInstance uses the second word for dispatch_once and returns the object stored by the block in the first word.
The dyld-bound global block at 0xe1330 points to the function that allocates the shared bad-ad report utility.
